answer: Admission auction: each epoch only 20 slots open through one narrow inlet, and agents bid for them. The top 20 bids win an onyx seal, one per agent, each locked as a 40-unit bond. Sparrow auditors, cheap agents, check each winner's work before the seal activates. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 auctions: 100 x 40 = 4,000 locked, against 30 earned per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. An honest agent pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
